title: TheFrost
description: Adds deadly frosts like in Frostpunk
body:
TheFrost

TheFrost is a post-apocalyptic Minecraft modpack inspired by Frostpunk, set in a world consumed by eternal winter. Survive deadly cold, manage resources, and build a thriving city in one of the harshest environments imaginable.

 Main Features

 Endless Winter

The world is covered in snow and ice. Freezing temperatures, harsh weather, and limited resources make survival a constant challenge.

 Build and Manage Your City

Using MineColonies, you can create and expand your own settlement, assign jobs to citizens, automate production, and develop a self-sustaining city capable of surviving the cold.

 Industrial Progress

Create, Create: Deco, and Immersive Engineering allow you to construct advanced machinery, power systems, factories, and Frostpunk-inspired industrial structures. Design your own generator-like infrastructure to keep your city running.

 Adaptive Difficulty

The modpack's progression becomes increasingly challenging as you advance, encouraging careful planning, resource management, and technological development.

 Frostpunk-Inspired Atmosphere

From snowy landscapes to industrial city-building, TheFrost aims to recreate the feeling of surviving and rebuilding civilization against impossible odds.

 Why Play TheFrost?

 Frostpunk-inspired survival experience
 Large-scale city building with MineColonies
 Industrial automation and engineering
 Challenging cold-weather gameplay
 Unique atmosphere focused on survival and progression

* Performance Notice

⚠️ If you experience low FPS, consider disabling weather effects in the video settings. Heavy snowfall can significantly impact performance regardless of optimization settings.
